name: Sign-up form validates account details
description: Verifies the sign-up form blocks short passwords before account submission.
steps: Open the sign-in screen
Switch to Create account
Enter a valid email and a password shorter than eight characters
Submit the form
expected: The form blocks submission and displays the password length requirement.

name: Create dynamic website and uploaded PDF QR codes
covers: PDF QR destination and branded redirect
description: Verifies a website QR and a real uploaded PDF QR can be created and exported.
steps: Sign in
Create a Website QR named Campaign with destination https://example.com/campaign and save it
Create a PDF QR and upload a PDF smaller than 20 MB
Save it and download PNG, SVG and PDF exports
expected: The website QR uses its branded redirect and the PDF QR opens the uploaded PDF file.

name: Create contact, text, email and SMS QR payloads
description: Verifies common non-URL QR formats show the right fields and encode their supplied data.
steps: Create a Contact QR with first name, last name, job title, phone and email
Create a Plain text QR with a message
Create an Email QR with recipient, subject and message
Create an SMS QR with phone number and message
expected: Each QR type presents its own relevant fields and saves a static payload without asking for a generic URL.

name: Choose a social platform and Telegram destination
description: Verifies social QR creation is platform-specific and Telegram lets the user choose a channel or group.
steps: Open the QR builder and select Social profile
Choose Telegram from the platform buttons
Choose Telegram channel
Enter a channel link and save
Edit or create another social QR and choose Instagram
expected: The QR form retains the selected platform and destination link, with Telegram channel/group options.

name: Validate required data and use the builder on mobile
description: Verifies missing PDF/social data is rejected and the type-specific forms remain usable on mobile.
steps: Open the QR builder on mobile and select PDF
Submit without uploading a PDF and verify validation
Select Social profile and choose Instagram
Submit without a destination link and verify validation
expected: Invalid submissions are blocked with clear messages and the mobile builder remains usable.
